text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp season has 
arrived once again.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list:
Let's make sure to take good care of our 
health.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. There is no time to stay down. 
And above all else...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm not who I was back then. And neither 
are you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Hm. I understand the situation 
regarding Biwa Hayahide. I will inform the 
President myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Brian, it's you. Honestly, 
calling out to me from behind like that...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You're her sister, aren't you? Didn't you 
hear? She said she'd be joining us midway 
through.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Forget it. If it hasn't reached your 
ears, it couldn't have been that important 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Focus on the training camp. I'm sure that 
is what your sister would want."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the Senior summer training 
camp.
